name: TrueSignal Token Receiver saturated for 15 minutes
description: A Token Receiver kept refusing connections on one listener for 15 minutes (three or more receiver_saturated reports; the sensor sends at most one per listener every 5 minutes). Sustained saturation is a flood against the internet-facing receiver and can hide beacon traffic.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Large recursive resolvers retrying aggressively after a delegation change on the beacon zone.
Internet-wide scanners hitting HTTP port 80 on the DMZ address.
note:
## Triage
1. `truesignal.details.top_source_refusals` lists the heaviest sources; `truesignal.details.distinct_sources` shows whether it is one host or many.
2. `refused_per_source` high: a few sources (rate-limit or block them at the edge). `refused_total_cap` high: many sources, a distributed flood.
3. While saturated, beacons may be missed: look for beacon traffic in the edge firewall logs for the receiver's address.
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and event.action:"receiver_saturated" and not truesignal.whitelisted:true and not truesignal.known_scanner:true
